{{Top|leg}}
'''Plasspecs''' were a form of corrective [[Eye/Legends|eye]]-wear worn by those with impaired vision. As advances were made in medicine plasspecs became increasingly obsolete, but individuals continued to wear them, whether because of allergic reaction to medications or other reasons.
